name: io.github.ap311036/timetree-mcp
title: TimeTree MCP
description: Access TimeTree calendars, events, memos, comments, labels, and background change monitoring through a direct HTTPS MCP server with explicit confirmation for writes.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: TimeTree account email. Optional when the macOS Keychain contains the email.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: TimeTree account password. Prefer macOS Keychain or a password file instead of passing this directly.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a password file with restricted permissions, preferably mode 600.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional TimeTree web base URL override. Defaults to https://timetreeapp.com.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP User-Agent override for the direct HTTPS transport.
